overview_description.description:
Away is a modern travel and lifestyle brand. The company is a vertically-integrated company offering beautiful, high-quality luggage at an affordable price point.

Away designs special objects for modern travel. It started with luggage, designed with thoughtful features that solve real travel problems—for life. Now all that’s left is the world in front of you and the people you share it with. Because getting Away means getting more out of every trip to come.

product.name: The Bigger Carry-On
product.description: A hard-sided carry-on suitcase designed for travel, offering lightweight and durable construction with ample packing space.

product.name: The Large
product.description: A large-sized hard-sided suitcase built for extended trips, providing durable protection and spacious interior for packing.

product.name: The Medium Flex
product.description: A medium-sized suitcase with a flexible shell designed to offer durability and expandability for travel packing needs.

product.name: The Everywhere Bag
product.description: A versatile travel bag designed for daily use and travel, featuring multiple compartments and a trolley sleeve for convenience.

product.name: The Commuter Backpack
product.description: A backpack designed for commuting and travel, featuring a padded laptop compartment and trolley sleeve for integration with luggage.

product.name: The Insider Packing Cubes
product.description: A set of packing cubes designed to organize clothing and accessories within luggage for efficient packing and unpacking.
